candidates.title: Claude Cowork moves new Pro and Max tasks to Anthropic's cloud
candidates.summary: Anthropic removed the local-only option for new Cowork tasks on Pro and Max, moving the agent loop and code execution into per-session cloud sandboxes while brokering local file and browser access through Claude Desktop.
candidates.what_changed: From October 6, new Pro and Max Cowork tasks run on Anthropic's servers. Existing local tasks stay local; cloud sessions access connected local resources only through the online desktop app, and files required in the cloud are copied selectively.
candidates.why_it_matters: The visible workflow now crosses a different trust boundary. Background and cross-device execution become possible, but local data may be processed remotely, endpoint tools cannot inspect cloud execution, and the desktop app becomes a privileged broker.
candidates.engineer_takeaway: Reassess data-classification, network-egress, connected-folder, connector-permission, observability, and endpoint-visibility assumptions before using cloud Cowork for sensitive engineering work. Use Claude Code desktop where execution and history must remain on one machine.

evidence.rationale: Anthropic's current help and architecture documentation explicitly state the October 6 plan change and describe the cloud sandbox, brokered local access, egress, credential, and observability boundaries.
evidence.independent_validation: No independent security validation or live sandbox inspection was performed in this run.
evidence.claim_scope: The story reports Anthropic's documented runtime change and architecture; it does not claim that the isolation or permission controls were independently verified.

signal.rationale: The change alters execution location, data flow, monitoring visibility, and control assumptions for a broadly available agentic work surface.

signal.rationale: If released as described, Beam could be a consequential open-weight reasoning and agent model.
